item.title: Bowen: Trump has called for an Iran uprising but the lessons from Iraq in 1991 loom large
item.summary: The US president might learn that starting wars is much easier than ending them, writes the BBC's international editor.

item.title: 'Even under missiles we carry on living' - how young Iranians are coping with war
item.summary: Iranians say they are sheltering at home and rarely venturing out on near-empty streets as the US-Israeli bombing campaign continues.

item.title: Ships hit in Strait of Hormuz as countries agree to release emergency oil reserves
item.summary: Pressure has intensified on the strait, one of the world's most important shipping lanes, since Israel and the US attacked Iran late last month.

item.title: EU and UK demand Israel stop surge in West Bank settler violence since Iran war
item.summary: Six Palestinians have been killed during attacks by settlers in the West Bank since the start of Israel's war, the UN says.

item.title: US strikes minelaying ships in Iran after warning of 'intense' day of bombing
item.summary: US intelligence assets believe Iran is preparing to deploy naval mines in the Strait of Hormuz, the world's busiest oil shipping channel.

item.title: War expands to central Beirut as Israeli strike kills Iranians in luxury hotel
item.summary: Israel's military says it targeted Quds Force operatives after a return to war with Lebanon's Hezbollah movement, but Iran says they were diplomats.

item.title: Why air strikes on Tehran oil facilities are causing black rain
item.summary: Air strikes have damaged at least four oil facilities since US-Israeli attacks on Iran began last month.

item.title: 'I just want to be able to sleep': Attacks in Iran rock cities and cut power
item.summary: Iranians in Tehran and Karaj tell the BBC they are exhausted and struggling to sleep after 10 days of Israeli and US attacks.

item.title: Lebanon calls for talks with Israel on plan to end Hezbollah conflict
item.summary: President Aoun outlines a path towards "permanent security and stability", as Israeli strikes targeting Hezbollah continue.

item.title: Strikes shake Iran cities as crowds rally in support of Mojtaba Khamenei
item.summary: Iran and Israel continue to exchange attacks, as supporters of Khamenei celebrate the decision to name him supreme leader.
